sources.excerpt: The 2026 Summer Youth Olympics opens in Dakar, Senegal, marking the first IOC event in Africa.
The 2026 Summer Youth Olympics will feature 153 events in 25 sports.

it is now scheduled to be held there for 14 days—from 31 October to 13 November 2026, becoming the first IOC event to be held in Africa and the first Youth Olympic Games under the IOC presidency of Kirsty Coventry
On 29 October 2026, US$6.3 billion worth of digital assets were stolen from Binance, a cryptocurrency exchange
The exchange hack is the largest ever cryptocurrency heist, surpassing the $1.5 billion Bybit hack in 2025, with the most affected blockchains being that of Ethereum and Bitcoin.
Binance, having initially halted all trades, has stated it will cover all losses, while approximately $3 billion of the stolen stablecoins have been frozen.
In the hills of north-west Morocco, overlooking the river that gives the site its name, research at Oued Beht is bringing to light a previously unknown chapter of the region’s past.
New excavations have clarified the existence of a multi-phase ditch, rampart and wall built across a narrow section of the Oued Beht ridge between the river and a ravine.
Our new study shows how we uncovered the earliest known large-scale construction of a probably defensive nature in north Africa beyond the Nile Valley. It’s about 4,000 to 3,500 years old.
